name: kosif-whatsapp
description: Send WhatsApp text, PDFs, images, files and bundles from ChatGPT, with connection and delivery checks and bridge account linking when available.

interface.shortDescription: Send WhatsApp messages and files from ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Use KOSIF WhatsApp from normal ChatGPT chats or Work to send text, images, PDFs, files and bundles, check connection and delivery status, and use account-linking tools when the bridge exposes them.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my WhatsApp is connected.
Send a WhatsApp message to a phone number.
Send a WhatsApp message with a PDF or image.
Connect or relink my WhatsApp account.
